assumptions.label: Weather availability of launch days andoya
assumptions.rationale: Mean wind 12 kn, mean gusts about 25 kn, close to the Spectrum ground wind limit of about 20 to 24 kn derived from the scrub on 4 Sep 2026 (24 kn). Autumn/winter worse with storms and icing, summer better. Evidence: flight 1 about 6 days of wind delay, flight 2 at least 2 wind scrubs. No daily statistics, hence expert estimate.

assumptions.label: Weather availability of launch days nova_scotia
assumptions.rationale: Drivers: hurricane season June to November (3 to 4 events per year for Canada), winter storms and icing, fog on about 115 days (visibility, tracking, sea area). No wind statistics for Canso, hence a wide range.

assumptions.label: Weather availability of launch days kourou_elm
assumptions.rationale: Ground wind practically never limiting (maximum 83 km/h since 1968), no hurricane risk. Drivers are thunderstorms/heavy rain in the rainy season (191 days with precipitation, 80 with >= 10 mm) and upper-level winds from mid June to mid August (Vega VV16 waited about 13 days). Thunderstorm days are a gap.

assumptions.label: Weather availability of launch days saxavord_isar
assumptions.rationale: High = operator figure of 95% of days with a 3 h window below 30 kn in spring/autumn, discounted for winter and for a stricter Spectrum limit (about 20 to 24 kn). Base as Andøya, given a similar North Atlantic location; 204 rain days. Operator figure not independently verified.

assumptions.label: Weather availability of launch days esrange_isar
assumptions.rationale: Inland location with probably less ground wind than the coastal sites (gap: no wind statistics). Drivers are cold down to -42 C and icing (snow cover from late Sept. to mid May), upper-level winds and summer thunderstorms. Evidence: wind scrub BROR 2023 with 1 day of delay.

assumptions.label: Weather availability of launch days santa_maria
assumptions.rationale: Mean wind 11 kn, but mean gusts 27 kn (Atlantic location). Summer very favourable (June/July 4 rain days each), winter worse with Atlantic lows, rare hurricanes (Gordon 2012). No campaign experience, hence expert estimate.

assumptions.label: Weather delay per launch campaign andoya
assumptions.rationale: Flight 1: around 6 days (24.03. to 30.03.2025); flight 2: wind scrub 04.09., launch 05.09.2026, plus one further wind-related scrub. Base averaged, High for winter campaigns.

assumptions.label: Weather delay per launch campaign nova_scotia
assumptions.rationale: No launch campaigns with orbital rockets; analogy to Andøya, High for hurricane or winter conditions.

assumptions.label: Weather delay per launch campaign kourou_elm
assumptions.rationale: Mostly no weather delays; outlier Vega VV16 with about 13 days of upper-level wind in June 2020.

assumptions.label: Weather delay per launch campaign saxavord_isar
assumptions.rationale: No orbital launch yet; launch slots only Mon/Wed/Fri 16:00 to 20:00 stretch every weather-related scrub to 2 to 3 calendar days.

assumptions.label: Weather delay per launch campaign esrange_isar
assumptions.rationale: Sounding rocket campaigns with short wind scrubs (BROR 2023: 1 day); for orbital launches in winter, cold and icing add to this.

assumptions.label: Weather delay per launch campaign santa_maria
assumptions.rationale: No campaign experience; summer favourable, winter with Atlantic lows.
